parameters.description: Pacific report-date range for trend visuals

dataSource.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| extend Value = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| project Value, Label = Value
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value desc

AIQDailyAgents()
| project Value = Agent, Label = Agent
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

AIQDailyIssues()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| project Value = IssueId, Label = strcat(IssueId, ' - ', IssueTitle)
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

AIQDailyIssues()
| project Value = Result, Label = Result
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

AIQDailyIssues()
| project Value = Ownership, Label = Ownership
| distinct Value, Label
| order by Value asc

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| top 1 by ReportDate desc
| project QualityScore
tiles.title: Latest quality score

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| project ReportDate, ['Quality score'] = QualityScore, ['Pass threshold'] = QualityThreshold
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Quality improvement trend

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize Days = count() by Status
| order by Status asc
tiles.title: Run outcomes

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| project ReportDate, ['Field quality'] = FieldQualityScore, ['Clean-card precision'] = CleanCardPrecision
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Score components

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend IssueMatchRate = round(100.0 * IssuesCorrect / iff(IssuesExpected == 0, 1, IssuesExpected), 1), BaselineCleanRate = round(100.0 * BaselinePassed / 5.0, 1)
| project ReportDate, ['Issue match rate'] = IssueMatchRate, ['Baseline clean rate'] = BaselineCleanRate
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Coverage and baseline health

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| project ReportDate, NoiseCards, UnverifiedCards
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Noise and incomplete evaluations

tiles.query:
AIQDailyAgents()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend MatchRate = round(100.0 * IssuesCorrect / iff(IssuesExpected == 0, 1, IssuesExpected), 1)
| project ReportDate, Agent, MatchRate
| order by ReportDate asc
tiles.title: Issue match rate by Agent

tiles.query:
AIQDailyFields()
| where ReportDate between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize PassRate = round(100.0 * countif(Passed) / count(), 1) by Field
| order by PassRate asc
tiles.title: Field pass rate

tiles.query:
AIQDailyRuns()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| top 1 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, Status, QualityScore, FieldQualityScore, CleanCardPrecision, BaselinePassed, IssuesCorrect, IssuesExpected, NoiseCards, ReportUrl
tiles.title: Selected daily run

tiles.query:
AIQDailyBaselines()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| top 50 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, Agent, Owner, AgentType, Framework, Status, Verdict, Ownership, InsightCount, RuntimeEvidenceComplete, OwnershipReason, AgentReportUrl
tiles.title: Healthy baseline results

tiles.query:
AIQDailyIssues()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| where isempty(_issue) or IssueId == _issue
| where isempty(_result) or Result == _result
| where isempty(_ownership) or Ownership == _ownership
| top 250 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, Agent, Owner, IssueId, IssueTitle, Category, Severity, Result, Detail, Ownership, FieldsPassed, FieldsExpected, CardCount, ObservedCount, RuntimeEvidenceComplete, FailingFields = tostring(FailingFields), IssueUrl, AgentReportUrl
tiles.title: Tested issue results

tiles.query:
AIQDailyHighlights()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where Section == 'What is working'
| order by ReportDate desc, Ordinal asc
| take 100
| project ReportDate, HighlightTitle, WhatHappened
tiles.title: What is working

tiles.query:
AIQDailyHighlights()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where Section == 'What needs improvement'
| order by ReportDate desc, Ordinal asc
| take 100
| project ReportDate, HighlightTitle, WhatHappened, NeededBehavior
tiles.title: What needs improvement

tiles.query:
AIQDailyAgents()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| top 50 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, Agent, Owner, AgentType, Framework, BaselineVerdict, IssuesCorrect, IssuesExpected, IssuesPartial, IssuesFailed, NoiseCards, SelectedIssueIds = tostring(SelectedIssueIds), AgentReportUrl
tiles.title: Test Agent context

tiles.query:
AIQDailyIssues()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| where isempty(_issue) or IssueId == _issue
| where isempty(_result) or Result == _result
| where isempty(_ownership) or Ownership == _ownership
| top 100 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, Agent, IssueId, IssueTitle, Category, Severity, Result, Detail, Ownership, ExpectedRootCause, ExpectedFix, OwnershipReason, FailingFields = tostring(FailingFields), IssueUrl
tiles.title: Expected issue and observed outcome

tiles.query:
AIQDailyCards()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| where isempty(_issue) or IssueId == _issue
| where isempty(_result) or Result == _result
| where isempty(_ownership) or Ownership == _ownership
| top 250 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, TargetKind, Agent, IssueId, IssueTitle, CardIndex, CardTitle, Category, Severity, Result, Verdict, Evaluation, FindingType, Ownership, Confidence, OwnershipReason, Reasoning, PassingFields = tostring(PassingFields), FailingFields = tostring(FailingFields), AgentReportUrl
tiles.title: Generated card assessment and reasoning

tiles.query:
AIQDailyFields()
| extend ReportDateKey = format_datetime(ReportDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
| where isempty(_reportDate) or ReportDateKey == _reportDate
| where isempty(_agent) or Agent == _agent
| where isempty(_issue) or IssueId == _issue
| where isempty(_result) or Result == _result
| top 500 by ReportDate desc
| project ReportDate, Agent, IssueId, IssueTitle, Result, Field, Passed
tiles.title: Required field outcomes
